description: CRIT-201 requires 'a single call-graph root reaching every one of REQ-201/202/203/204/205/206/301/302/303/304/305/306's own exported functions/scripts', and 'FAIL if... any EFFECTFUL step fires out of order or is skipped'. REQ-307's own Canonical call order step 5 text explicitly states: 'REQ-303's own internal two-pass funding-gate sequencing (REQ-304) runs entirely within this step.' REQ-304's own effectful funding step is therefore entirely unreached by spawn-orchestrator.mjs's real call graph -- not merely unordered, but skipped outright -- which is a direct FAIL condition under CRIT-201's own passThreshold text.
